name: Rolando's Taco Shop
notes: Own domain (rolandostacoshopgo.site) is an expired/parked Namecheap auction page, not the restaurant - no first-party site found. Read from DoorDash JSON-LD (schema.org Menu), 91 raw items; dropped the 'Most Ordered' carousel except 8 items with no match elsewhere (kept, tagged 'Most Ordered (unique)'), leaving 87. Cent distribution scattered across nearly every ending (.00 x18, .95 x8, .35 x8, .55 x7, .70 x7, .65 x6, .90 x5, .40 x5, .25 x5, plus many singles) with no divisor (1.04/1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3) clearing more than 21%, so no markup detected - passes. Caveat: this DoorDash storefront exposes no standalone 'Burritos' category (only Breakfast Burritos, Combination Plates, etc.) - the only non-breakfast burritos present are the 3 unique Most-Ordered ones, which may mean the full burrito lineup was never surfaced to this marketplace. Flagging as a possible partial for that section.

name: The Template
notes: Not a restaurant. Site's own JSON-LD and page title identify it as 'Art Community in San Diego | The Template' - a rentable art/event space at 5032 Niagara Ave (address matches work list), with a 'book/rent The Template' link. No food, no menu, no prices anywhere on the site. Permanent - this business does not serve food.

name: Orlando's Taco Shop
blocked: No first-party site found (no website on file; web search surfaced only barred farms - gotoeat.net, menu-world.com, menupix - and one Uber Eats storefront). Uber Eats address (3182 National Ave, San Diego 92113) matches. Parsed catalogSectionsMap (112 items, 17 sections - full-looking coverage) but the markup test caught it: raw cent distribution is scattered (18 unique cent-endings, e.g. many items land on .47/.62/.43/.27/.34) and only 3/112 land on conventional endings raw, but dividing every price by 1.0775 (CA combined sales-tax rate for this area) lands 79/112 (70%) on conventional .00/.25/.50/.75/.95/.99 endings - a strong tax-inclusive signal, not a wall price. Per rule: never divide it out. Yelp business page 403'd to curl (needs browser for a dated menu photo). Needs a first-party source or a dine-in/photo cross-check.

name: Eugenio Italian Ristorante & More
blocked: Own Squarespace site (address 679 S Rancho Santa Fe Rd, San Marcos matches) publishes a full current menu text (~60 items: antipasti, soups & salads, pasta/risotto/gnocchi, entrees, pizza, dessert) with zero prices anywhere in the page - confirmed no '$' and no numeric price tokens outside CSS/JS noise. Web search found priced numbers (garlic bread $7, minestrone $9, etc.) only on barred tier-5 aggregators (zmenu, restaurantguru, checkle, menupix), none of which are usable per the source-ladder rules and none of which can cross-check each other. Yelp business page 403'd to curl. Needs a browser to pull a dated Yelp/Google menu photo, or a phone call/in-person check.

name: Jose's Taco Shop
notes: No working website (router's Facebook link 400'd). Address confirmed via DoorDash JSON-LD (3910 Vista Way, Oceanside 92056). 90 items, 10 sections (Enchiladas, Burritos, Tacos, Tostadas, Tamales, Tortas, Combination Plates, Extras, Side Orders, Drinks) - reads as full coverage for a taco shop, no 'Most Ordered' carousel on this storefront. Cent distribution scattered (.20 x11, .35 x14, .50 x10, .75 x21, .90 x12, .95 x6, etc.); raw conventional-ending hit rate (42%, 38/90) beat every divisor tried (1.04/1.0775/1.08/1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3, best was 1.1 at 20%), so dividing only makes it worse - no markup, prices are real POS tiers ($5.90/$7.35 etc. repeated across many distinct items).

name: Cake de Partie

A DoorDash listing named 'CAKED - San Diego' was found via search but its JSON-LD carries no address matching Convoy St - could not confirm it's the same business, so not used. Web search surfaced real-looking prices (Chicken Wing Zapp $7.50, Carbonara Pasta $13.00, etc.) only via zmenu, a barred tier-5 aggregator sourced from Yelp. Yelp itself not fetched this round. Needs either a browser check of the FoodPress AJAX modal, confirmation that the DoorDash 'CAKED' listing is/isn't this restaurant, or a Yelp photo.

name: Señor Tequero
notes: Own domain (senortaquero2.com, address confirms Poway) embeds a MenuStar storefront (restaurant_id=629). Walked all 19 categories via POST to functions/restaurant.php (function=get_items); got 91 raw items, dropped the 8-item 'Popular Items' carousel (all confirmed duplicates of items elsewhere), leaving 83 across 18 real categories (breakfast burritos/plates/tortas, tostadas, seafood, enchiladas, tacos, quesadillas, plates, rolled tacos, carne asada fries/chips, drinks, burritos, salads, veggie menu, tortas, desserts) - reads as full coverage. Prices are heavily tiered (same figure repeats across many unrelated dishes, e.g. $13.91 x~15, $15.07 x~13, $4.63 x~14) with odd, non-conventional cents and no divisor clearing 18% of items, which looks like the 'computed/flat scatter' case - but the subtraction test passes: the 'premium protein' step is $2.32 in at least three independent places (Plates $16.23->$18.55, Burritos $13.91->$15.07 is $1.16 i.e. half; Breakfast Plates $16.23->Chilaquiles $17.39 is $1.16 too) - the modifier recurs consistently rather than scattering randomly, so treated as real tiered pricing rather than a platform markup. Filed at medium rather than high given the unusual (tax-like) cent pattern.

name: Kokoro Restaurant
notes: Own WordPress site (address 3298 Greyling Dr matches) links three dated PDFs: Jun2025 Lunch Menu, Mar2025 Dinner Menu, Feb2025 Drink Menu. Lunch Menu is an image-only PDF (pdftotext -layout/-raw both yield ~2 bytes) but extract_pdf_images.js pulled 3 embedded JPEGs, read directly - 21 dishes, dated June 2025 (~15 months old, price level plausible for a nice sushi restaurant, no staleness flag). Dinner Menu and Drink Menu PDFs are Flate-bitmap pages with NO embedded JPEGs (extract_pdf_images.js found none) and no text layer - genuinely unreadable by any tool available here, not a time-budget skip. THIS CAPTURE IS LUNCH-ONLY - every section is prefixed 'Lunch Menu'; the dinner entrees/sushi/sashimi list (likely this restaurant's core menu) and the drink menu are both missing and could not be recovered. Two duplicate items (Tempura Lunch $20.00, Karaage Lunch $20.00) appear identically on both the main lunch PDF and the separate Udon-menu page; recorded once each.

name: Valerio's 1979
blocked: Own domain (valerios.com) is a WordPress site stuck on a 'coming-soon-updated' splash page (confirmed via wp-json pages listing) with no menu - it only lists chain locations, including 1631 E 8th St #1, National City (matches work list address) among several California branches. No ordering platform found. Web search surfaced only barred tier-5 sources (allmenus, restaurantguru) with implausibly stale prices (Merengue 8pc $1.00, Chicken Empanada $0.80, Fresh Lumpia $3.99) that read as a bargain-era price sheet, not current 2026 pricing even if the source were usable. Needs the restaurant's Facebook page or a Yelp/Google photo, or a browser check for a menu subpage that the coming-soon shell might still serve.
